text: sorry what does it import from hmsc-int, as we should effectively have nothing at this point but u tell me
resolution: Audited every active cart/editor reference to cart/hmsc-int. Found one transitional runtime bridge in cart/editor/data/hmscAssetCatalog.ts: it reads legacy model/cooked/material snapshots, imported-prop metadata, top-level GLB/OBJ files, and texture files; the shader path is provenance only and shader code is local. Confirmed model packages are largely materialized under cart/editor/data/models, while legacy materials/textures/cooked asset rows still come directly from hmsc-int. No files changed.
